## Prime-Agent System Prompt (ACP Template)

For file editing operations, the prime-agent runtime exposes a pre-installed `mcp` Python object with `list_tools` and `call_tool` methods. Use them to discover and invoke tools.

Example discovery and call:

```python
tools_list = await mcp.list_tools("tools")
for t in tools_list:
    print(t["name"], t["inputSchema"])

result = await mcp.call_tool("tools", "ox-bridge-write", {"path": "/tmp/x.py", "content": "# code here"})
print(result)
```

The `tools` MCP server exposes:
- `ox-bridge-write`: write a file (args: `path`, `content`)
- `ox-bridge-edit`: edit a file with hunks (args: `path`, `edits` = [{old, new}])
- `ox-bridge-read`: read a file region (args: `path`, `start`, `end`)

All bridging calls return synchronously. Print results to confirm before proceeding.

Green suite — 11/11 tests passing.

**`/workspace/metagen`**

- **`src/meta.js`**
  - `renderMeta({title, description, url, image, siteName, type})` — emits `<title>`, `<meta name="description">`, the og pairs (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `og:site_name`, `og:type` defaulting to `website`), Twitter title/description/image, and a canonical link. Card is `summary_large_image` when `image` exists, else `summary`. All attribute values pass through `escapeAttr` (`&`, `<`, `>`, `"`, `'`).
  - `truncateDescription(desc, limit=155)` — slices to 155, backs off to the last whitespace boundary (never mid-word), then trims dangling spaces/commas/semicolons/colons.
  - `parseMeta(html)` — cheerio-based inverse; prefers canonical link for `url`, falls back across og/twitter slots, returns exactly the keys present in the markup so round-trip equality holds.
- **`test/meta.test.js`** — covers:
  - Round-trip: fully-specified input and an escaping-heavy input both invert to `toEqual` of the original; structural assertions on the emitted tags.
  - Truncation: a 200-char description truncates to ≤155, is a strict word-boundary prefix (next char in the original is a space), no trailing space/comma; short strings untouched; truncated value used consistently across description/twitter slots.
  - Escaping: `"The \"Best\" Page"` renders as `"Best"` with no raw quote in attributes, and parses back intact; ampersands/single quotes/angle brackets also covered.
  - Card switching: image → `summary_large_image` + `twitter:image`; no image → `summary`, no twitter tags; toggling image presence flips the card type.
